purpose: Guards Flyway SQL assumptions that have caused startup or environment-safety regressions.
businessRules: Category configuration is seeded by Flyway before backend startup is production-ready.
Seed SQL must qualify overlapping family and seed columns such as display_name and sort_order.
Shared UAT login seed data must live under db/dev-uat-migration and must not be part of the production migration location.
The shared UAT OTP must remain exactly six digits.
